verdict.rationale: Thoropass documents auditor-mapped Unified Controls: all offered frameworks map to a single core control list. You can filter by framework or work on all frameworks at once, and view framework controls alongside Unified Controls. Multi-framework action items mean requirements already addressed by another framework don't have to be redone, and per-framework mapping guides exist for SOC 2, HIPAA and HITRUST. Missing for 10: ISO 27001 is never explicitly named in the mapping evidence, there is no clear documentation of a visual overlap/coverage view across frameworks, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration.
